project.name: Farinuff Flight 2.5D Sprite Direction
project.purpose: Reference-lock the 2.5D pixel rendering direction and update the runtime player, enemy, and boss sprite families without losing role readability or the 1280x720 gameplay scale.
project.audience: Game art, gameplay, and rendering implementation
notes: The supplied gameplay render is a style anchor only; current runtime strips are identity anchors.
Sprite output contract: 128x128 logical cells, 64x64 center anchor, four horizontal idle frames, true transparency.
Keep the player visually small enough to preserve playfield readability in the 1280x720 viewport.

style_lock.medium: Stylized low-poly 3D hard-surface spacecraft presented as crisp pixel-art sprite renders, with geometry readable through stepped planes rather than painterly brushwork.
style_lock.rendering: Nearest-neighbor pixel presentation with compact 4-5 step toon bands, selective one-pixel dithering, dark occlusion pockets, and controlled emissive bloom around engines, weapons, and reactor cores.
style_lock.line_and_edge: Hard faceted contours with a near-black navy outline or occlusion rim, stepped diagonal edges, pixel stair-stepping, and no anti-aliased vector linework.
style_lock.shape_language: Compact readable spacecraft built from pointed fuselages, swept wings, modular armor plates, inset reactor cores, and small engine blocks; each gameplay role receives a distinct silhouette before color is considered.
palette: background and occlusion: near-black #020309 through deep navy #071129
player: ice white #D7EEFF, cyan #6BD7FF and electric cyan #00C8FF over dark navy structural planes
basic and assault: scarlet #FF3B24, ember orange #FF6B24, and reactor gold #FFC14D
fast: hot orange #FF8A24 with small cyan-white targeting accents
bomber: toxic green #6CFF7A, lime #B7FF4A, and restrained warm core highlights
sniper: cyan-blue #28BFFF with red-orange reactor contrast
tank and bosses: deep violet #35106E, electric purple #7A2BFF, magenta #FF3CCF, and white-hot reactor centers
powerups and high-value accents: gold #FFC04D or pink-white #FFB6F5
style_lock.lighting: Cool cyan key light from upper left, deep violet fill and rim from the surrounding space, hard planar occlusion, and small white-hot emissive cores that bloom only a few pixels beyond the source.
style_lock.texture: Sparse pixel dithering, subtle CRT scanline breakup, tiny star-like specular pixels, and stepped emissive halos; surfaces remain clean and game-readable with no smooth photographic noise or soft gradients.
style_lock.composition: For sprite assets, one centered isolated spacecraft per logical frame on true transparency, with generous empty margin and a visually stable 64x64 anchor; gameplay staging belongs to the 1280x720 scene and must not be baked into the sprites.
must_not_change: the existing runtime sprite families or their gameplay roles
the logical frame size, centered anchor, horizontal four-frame strip contract, or transparent background
the readable silhouette hierarchy between player, basic, fast, bomber, sniper, tank, and boss classes
the distinction between player cyan-white energy, enemy role colors, and the separate assault, bulwark, Tempest, Tempest Core, and Void Harbinger boss palettes
avoid: unrequested text or UI baked into sprite assets
backgrounds, stars, planets, beams, or HUD elements in transparent sprites
photorealistic rendering, smooth gradients, painterly brushwork, or anti-aliased vector edges
overly large player or enemy silhouettes that reduce playfield readability
unrequested topology changes, extra weapons, or copied boss/player compositions from the style anchor

style_profile.name: Farinuff 2.5D Pixel Fleet
style_profile.brief: Low-poly 3D spacecraft translated into compact transparent pixel-art sprites: hard faceted planes, stepped toon shading, near-black silhouettes, and hot cyan, orange, green, or magenta emissive cores against the deep-space palette of the supplied gameplay render.
style_profile.application: Apply this visual treatment to every player, enemy, and boss sprite while preserving each existing runtime role, silhouette, proportions, generation family, frame anchor, and transparent sprite-strip layout.
must_preserve: the supplied gameplay render as a style anchor for medium, rendering, palette relationships, edge treatment, texture, and lighting only
the current player and enemy sprite identities as separate identity anchors
128x128 logical frame cells, centered 64x64 anchors, four-frame horizontal strips, and transparent backgrounds
role-readable silhouettes and the existing player, enemy, and boss family distinctions

style_reference_images.description: User-approved 1280x720 gameplay render controlling the 2.5D low-poly spacecraft finish, deep-space contrast, cyan HUD-adjacent energy, violet boss materials, magenta emissive effects, crisp pixel edges, and small player read; do not copy its exact identities, layout, or object topology.

identity_lock.silhouette: Small compact forward-facing interceptor with a pointed central fuselage, short swept side wings, and a narrow lower engine cluster.
identity_lock.proportions: Width slightly greater than height; the ship stays compact inside the frame with generous transparent margin so it reads as a small 1280x720 gameplay object.
identity_lock.face_and_head: A centered dark cockpit/inset panel above a bright vertical cyan reactor or weapon channel; no humanoid face.
identity_lock.surface_details: Light hull planes, dark navy recesses, small angular wing plates, and three compact cyan engine/energy points.
identity_lock.personality_read: Precise, agile, and player-readable at a glance.

reference_images.description: Current runtime player strip; preserves the player silhouette, anchor, and frame spacing while the approved style changes the rendering finish.

identity_lock.silhouette: Small pointed red-orange enemy with a diamond-like nose, compact lateral fins, and a centered reactor.
identity_lock.proportions: Short, symmetric, and slightly wider than tall; clearly smaller than bosses and distinct from the thin fast class.
identity_lock.face_and_head: No face; a centered warm reactor aperture is the visual focal point.
identity_lock.surface_details: Angular red hull wedges, ember-orange bevels, dark crimson recesses, and small side fins.

identity_lock.proportions: Tall and slim with a strong vertical axis; substantially narrower than basic, bomber, or tank classes.
identity_lock.face_and_head: No face; a tiny high-contrast center or nose light communicates targeting and speed.
identity_lock.surface_details: Long orange-red central body, tiny swept fins, bright cyan-white targeting accent, and dark underside.

reference_images.description: Current evolved fast enemy silhouette and escalation reference.

identity_lock.silhouette: Broad green enemy with a wide wing or payload span, a compact central body, and visible side-mounted mass.
identity_lock.proportions: Wider than tall with the largest lateral spread among regular enemies; retains a readable central core.
identity_lock.face_and_head: No face; a pale central payload/reactor aperture sits inside the broad wing structure.
identity_lock.surface_details: Green hull planes, lime highlights, heavy side plates or payload pods, and dark structural joints.

reference_images.description: Current evolved bomber enemy silhouette and escalation reference.

identity_lock.face_and_head: No face; a small warm red-orange center aperture breaks the cool blue body.
identity_lock.surface_details: Cyan and blue vertical planes, tiny top antenna/fins, dark body recesses, and a warm reactor/aiming core.

identity_lock.face_and_head: No face; the bright central reactor aperture sits deep inside a dark armored housing.
identity_lock.surface_details: Deep-violet armor slabs, electric-purple bevels, dark occlusion between plates, and compact lower engine blocks.

identity_lock.silhouette: Large mechanically layered boss family built from a dominant central core and readable radial, shield, or pointed modules depending on the current boss form.

identity_lock.surface_details: Faceted dark-violet armor, near-black recessed planes, form-specific energy channels, modular side weapons, radial plates, and controlled white-hot cores.
